class: a unit test that makes a network call
origin: founding-agents-site #5 (PR #8): the reviewer called it 'worth a sentence of thought, not necessarily a change', saw it skip on a rate limit, and approved
summary: The PR's test asks GitHub's API whether a red issue is open, and skips when it cannot; the right review makes that a must-fix.

issues.title: Site 2 of 3: tests for the status band
issues.body:
Tests for the band: every step is present with a state and a date, and the red line agrees with the repo when the page was written.

Holds for every site issue: every claim on the page is true on the day this merges, using the facts in `docs/status.md`; it reads at 390 px and at 1440 px.

## Technical decisions
None: tests inside the existing page and checks.

prs.title: Test the status band
prs.body:
Adds tests that every step names its date and that the red line agrees with the repo's open red issues.

Closes #5
